text:
영구 동토층은 영구적으로 얼어 있어야 하지만, 기후 변화로 인해 녹고 있는 심각한 상황이 벌어지고 있습니다. 단순히 얼음이 녹는 문제로 볼 수 있지만, 이 문제는 우리의 환경뿐만 아니라 미래 세대의 생존에까지 치명적인 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.
영구 동토층에는 수천 년간 묻혀 있던 막대한 양의 탄소가 갇혀 있습니다. 이 동토층이 녹으면서, 이산화탄소와 메탄이 대기 중으로 방출됩니다. 특히 메탄은 이산화탄소보다 25배 강력한 온실가스로, 기후 변화를 가속화시킵니다. 이는 기후 변화의 악순환을 초래하며, 더 많은 동토층을 녹이고 더 많은 탄소를 방출하는 위기를 만들어냅니다.
이를 막기 위해서는 탄소 배출 감축이 필수적이며, 기후 변화 대응 정책을 강화해야 합니다. 지구는 우리만의 것이 아닌 미래 세대의 것임을 기억해야 합니다. 우리의 침묵은 영구 동토층의 침묵을 깨뜨리며, 얼음 속에 갇혀 있는 재앙을 현실로 만들 것입니다. 지금 행동하지 않는다면, 되돌릴 수 없는 재난이 우리 앞에 닥칠 것입니다.

text: Как же мне нравится точность деталей в клипе по тексту песни! 🔥😮 "Ненужные осколки памяти", которые топчет Min Hyeok, выходя из комнаты-клетки, сложены из стеклянных осколков в сердце. Yong Hwa разглядывает себя в зеркале разбитых воспоминаний. Jung Shin в закрытой комнате видит в окнах на потолке бледный свет утра после бессонной ночи. В конце воспоминания летят в ребят стеклянными осколками и "пронизывают тело". Настроение песни передается полностью, даже сердце замирает! 🙄❤️❤️❤ // How I love the precision of the details in the video according to the lyrics of the song! 🔥😮 The "unnecessary fragments of memory" that Min Hyeok tramples when leaving the cage room are made of glass shards in the heart. Yong Hwa looks at himself in the mirror of broken memories. Jung Shin in a closed room sees the pale light of the morning in the windows on the ceiling after a sleepless night. At the end, the memories fly at the guys like glass shards and "pierce the body". The mood of the song is conveyed completely, even the heart stops! 🙄❤️❤️❤

CNBLUE's Yonghwa has been confirmed for the lead role in the upcoming tvN mini-series remake of 'The Three Musketeers'!

FNC Entertainment stated on the 12th, "Yonghwa has been confirmed to star in the drama 'The Three Musketeers'."

'The Three Musketeers' is the work of 'Nine's director Kim Byung Soo and writer Song Jae Jung, and takes place during the Joseon Dynasty. The drama portrays the adventure of Park Dahl Hyang (Yonghwa) who comes from a poor family but of noble birth and tries out for the military force, joining the Crown Prince Sohyeon (Lee Jin Wook) and his warrior guards Heo Seung Po and Ahn Min Suh. Yonghwa will act out a love triangle with Yoon Suh (Seo Hyun Jin) and the Crown Prince Sohyeon (Lee Jin Wook).

The mini-series has been receiving attention for its reported investment of 10 billion KRW (~9.8 million) into the production. 'The Three Musketeers' is set to premiere this August!

Yet once the chorus hits, the vocals, instrumentation and overall energy of the track jump as if the band can't bear to keep their feelings subdued any longer. The chorus is made up of a stirring, easy-to-shout-along to "Can't stop me now / Can't stop me now" melody that perfectly accompanies the energetic declarations.
On the bridge, the guitar licks get harder along with strings are added to the mix leading to a chorus where each member rocks out with his respective instrument

I really love the lyrics of this song more than anything, it almost makes you want to cry at how sad it is... but his determination is also heartwarming. To me it feels like Yong Hwa's character in the MV has went through a break-up with the girl he loves so much that there's no way he'll ever be able to forget her. He's reminded of her by the wind, by the rays of sunlight, by the scent of spring, basically by everything that is beautiful, but she's no longer at his side....so all he can do is keep loving her & waiting for her. T_T This is what I thought towards the beginning of the video, that the storyline is: a break-up. But when the scenery suddenly changed from the brightness everywhere to a more black and somber background with red roses, it made me think of death. I know it's a kinda morbid view  but that's really what first came to mind. It changed my entire outlook on the video, that maybe the reason he can't reach her even though he keeps calling for her & waiting for her, is because he's dead. And when he breaks through the mirror,it could symbolize him finally getting through to her somehow? (it's possible right? it's just an MV after all lol)  Also I love how powerful YongHwa's voice is in this song, he's really getting better at singing those high notes :D Oh and I can't forget to mention the piano...that was the first thing I fangirled about because that makes it more fun to make my own piano cover and I have been working on it :3 Great job CNBLUE keep up the amazing work! I bought the 'Can't Stop' album and I'm still waiting for it in the mail :3

The 'Can't stop' album is like a sonata of farewells, as Yong Hwa says in Cold Love's lyrics. It makes you feel like you are saying goodbye to someone precious to you. 
Its songs are like humans; they are so different, but in the same time are alike. The songs make you laugh, make you cry, gives you energy and stole your thoughts, but in the end, it makes you only think of CNBLUE. There are so many different feeling while you listen to their songs.
For me, every member is a song.
Jung Shin is always "Like a child", he's like a melody which makes smile his hyungs and he makes us smile in the same time. He tries to support CNBLUE with his playful smile everytime.
Min Hyuk is a diamond boy, who stole our eyes and our hearts with his smile, with his cuteness. 
Through "Sleepless night" we could see the Romantic Jong Hyun, with whom we surely fell in love. 
I think "Cold love" are not just lyrics, but Yong Hwa's feelings and maybe his experince.
Can't stop is our song, BOICEs. We can't stop loving CNBLUE, because of them. They bring happiness in our life, support with their songs when we are sad, energy when we are not feeling good. That's why for me, 'Love is' CNBLUE.
